ccel_policy.direct_body_carriers: all 62 div1 elements in exact source order
ccel_policy.text_and_structure: Preserve every element tag, ordered attributes, text node, tail, XML comment, and source processing-instruction target/data. Any unsupported node fails closed.
ccel_policy.required_exact_ids: The ordered source div1 id list in the reconstruction profile must match exactly.

project_gutenberg_policy.member_scope: complete retained text file inventoried by physical line and byte range
project_gutenberg_policy.other_source_sermons: Each of the other 26 source-native sermon carriers must be listed with its exact line interval and an explicit not-selected disposition.
project_gutenberg_policy.selection_limit: Not-selected is a route disposition only; it does not establish that the carrier is outside the larger work or corpus.
project_gutenberg_policy.preservation: Keep each selected source-native label, physical line order, line text, and leading spaces. Do not assign a shared ordinal.
project_gutenberg_policy.provider_envelope: Inventory every physical line, including the BOM-bearing first line, title and contents matter, start/end markers, FINIS, and license text; nonselected wrapper lines are not sermon text in the TEI body.

failure_conditions: Any source hash, byte count, ordered carrier ID, source-native sermon label, line count, or declared selection changes.
Any source element, attribute, text, tail, comment, processing instruction, carrier, or physical line is missing, reordered, duplicated, invented, or silently normalized.
Any unknown source element or unsupported carrier lacks an explicit disposition.
Any TEI source carrier does not independently round-trip to its retained source event structure and content.
The candidate asserts a shared sermon ordinal, resolved collection/edition/part relationship, rights clearance, acceptance, release, or publication.
